subject.title: fix: network error hardening, session short-id entropy, extension load caching

question: Should this protected, grouped runtime-hardening PR land as one change after real runtime proof, or should its network and extension-cache portions be split for narrower ownership review?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes three lifecycle-sensitive runtime surfaces, and the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling rather than automated acceptance.

options.title: Review and land together
options.body: Accept the grouped hardening after redacted runtime evidence confirms dispatcher diagnostics and edited extension reload behavior.

options.title: Split the runtime concerns
options.body: Request separate network, session-ID, and extension-cache PRs if owners prefer independently reversible changes.

recommendation.title: Review and land together
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped hardening after redacted runtime evidence confirms dispatcher diagnostics and edited extension reload behavior.
